method: built-in browser; state read via getEligibleModels() after series length was stable for 3s; payload = criteria,date,splitMode,returnType + per model [time,net,buy,sell,alt_net,open,trades] for every point; SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(payload)
limitation: Hash-only goldens (plus summary). They prove the page reproduces itself; the engine-core task needs full series, to be dumped by the parity harness from the page and the engine side by side. Sets B and C show a single eligible model: confirmed the page still shows 1 after 12 s, so this is the page's behaviour, not a capture bug.

sets.note: only 1 model eligible after load for this view

known_findings: setReturnType is declared twice in the page; the later declaration wins at runtime, so the engine must carry the later one
